hero.title: Your sovereign e‑commerce store, ready in a few days.
hero.leadHtml: Colibri Starter is a command-line tool that creates your complete e‑commerce store, ready to be tailored by your team or a partner. Host it wherever you like, with no commission on your sales.

own.title: Why move away from a subscription platform
own.intro: On a subscription platform, you pay every month, often a commission on your sales, and your data stays with the vendor. With Colibri Starter, your store and your data stay with you.
rentItems: The subscription goes up with your revenue
Transaction fees and paid apps every month
Exporting your data is limited to what the vendor allows
The roadmap is up to the vendor
ownItems: No platform subscription, no commission on sales
Your store and your data belong to you
Switch partner, host or solution whenever you want
Adjust the features to your business

sovereignty.title: A sovereign store
sovereignty.intro: You decide where your store and your customers' data live.

options.title: In-house
options.p: On your servers or your cloud, your store joins the rest of your information system.

options.title: Get expert advice
options.p: Your partner recommends the hosting that fits your traffic, your budget and your constraints.

promiseItems: Your data, with no dependency on a vendor

found.leadHtml: Colibri Starter is a set of Castor commands (wait, what is Castor?) around a standard Sylius project. You create a project, then add or remove features as your needs evolve. Your project stays standard: any Symfony team can pick it up.

feats.html: sylius:init creates the project: Docker, Sylius, database, assets, fixtures and tests.
sylius:add installs, configures and migrates a plugin. sylius:remove takes it out again, configuration and migrations included.
sylius:theme:setup switches the whole store theme, removing the previous one first.
sylius:menu:remove hides the back-office entries you don't need.

ecosystem.title: A proven foundation
ecosystem.intro: Sylius has been running demanding stores for more than ten years. E‑commerce expertise and a track record of projects that few solutions can match.

benefits.title: Community-driven
benefits.p: Partners, solution vendors and freelancers keep the project alive.
